    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Account
    Represents a user account in the Library Management System.
    AccountRepository
    Repository interface for managing Account entities.
    AccountService
    Application service for managing user financial accounts in the Library Management System.
    AccountStatus
    Represents the status of a user account.
    AccountValidator
    Validator for Account entity operations.
    AdminCLI
    Administrator command-line interface for the Library Management System.
    AuthorizationService
    Utility class providing role-based authorization checks for the Library Management System.
    AuthService
    Singleton service managing user authentication and session state in the Library Management System.
    Book
    Represents a book in the Library Management System.
    BookDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing book information for use in the application layer.
    BookFineStrategy
    Fine calculation strategy for books.
    BookNotAvailableException
    Thrown when a book is currently unavailable for borrowing.
    BookNotFoundException
    Thrown when a requested book cannot be found.
    BookRepository
    Repository interface for managing Book entities.
    BookSearchStrategy
    Abstract base class for Book search strategies.
    BookService
    Application-level service responsible for coordinating book-related use cases.
    BookValidator
    Validator for Book entity fields.
    BorrowNotAllowedException
    Thrown when a user is not allowed to borrow items.
    CD
    Represents a CD in the library collection.
    CDFineStrategy
    Fine calculation strategy for CDs.
    CDRepository
    Repository interface for managing CD entities.
    CDSearchStrategy
    Abstract base class for CD search strategies.
    CDService
    Application-level service responsible for managing CD-related use cases.
    CDValidator
    Validator for CD entity fields.
    CLI
    Common interface for all Command Line Interface (CLI) components in the Library Management System.
    CLIFactory
    Factory class for creating the appropriate CLI implementation based on user role.
    CLIHelper
    Utility class providing reusable CLI helper methods for formatting and user interaction.
    CLILogger
    Centralized logger utility for CLI operations.
    ConsoleSchedulerLogger
    Console-based implementation of the SchedulerLogger interface.
    EmailService
    Singleton service for sending email notifications via Gmail SMTP.
    FilterByAvailabilityStrategy
    Strategy for filtering books by availability status.
    FilterByCategoryStrategy
    Strategy for filtering books by category/genre (case-insensitive partial match).
    FilterByYearStrategy
    Strategy for filtering books by publication year.
    FilterCDByAvailabilityStrategy
    Strategy for filtering CDs by availability status.
    FilterJournalByAvailabilityStrategy
    Strategy for filtering Journals by availability status.
    FineStrategy
    Strategy interface for calculating overdue fines.
    FineStrategyFactory
    Factory for creating fine calculation strategies based on item type.
    FineTransaction
    Represents a financial transaction related to fines in the library system.
    InvalidPasswordException
    Thrown when a user provides an incorrect password.
    ItemManagementServices
    Groups all services related to managing library items.
    ItemNotAvailableException
    Thrown when a library item is currently unavailable for borrowing.
    ItemNotFoundException
    Thrown when a requested library item cannot be found.
    ItemType
    Represents types of items available in the library.
    ItemTypeNotFoundException
    Thrown when an invalid or unsupported item type is referenced.
    Journal
    Represents a journal in the library collection.
    JournalFineStrategy
    Fine calculation strategy for journals.
    JournalSearchStrategy
    Abstract base class for Journal search strategies.
    JournalService
    Application service for coordinating journal management use cases.
    JournalsRepository
    Repository interface for managing Journal entities.
    JournalValidator
    Validator for Journal entity fields.
    LibraryApp
    Main entry point for the Library Management System application.
    LibraryCLI
    Main entry menu for the Library Management System.
    Loan
    Represents a loan of a library item to a user.
    LoanableItem
    Defines the contract for items that can be loaned to library users.
    LoanAlreadyExistsException
    Thrown when attempting to create a duplicate loan.
    LoanDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing a loan record.
    LoanManagementServices
    Groups all services related to managing loans in the library system.
    LoanNotFoundException
    Thrown when a requested loan cannot be found.
    LoanOverdueChecker
    Background task that checks for overdue loans and notifies affected users.
    LoanQueryService
    Service providing query operations for retrieving and filtering loan records.
    LoanRepository
    Repository interface for managing Loan entities.
    LoanService
    Application service coordinating loan operations in the Library Management System.
    LoanServiceContext
    Context object that bundles all dependencies required by LoanService.
    LoanStatsService
    Service providing statistical analysis and reporting for library loans.
    LoanValidator
    Validator for Loan entity fields.
    Notification
    Represents a notification sent to a user.
    NotificationObserver
    Observer interface for receiving notification events.
    NotificationService
    NotificationService
    NotificationType
    Represents types of notifications sent to users.
    NotificationValidator
    Validator for Notification entity fields.
    PasswordReuseException
    Thrown when a user attempts to reuse a previous password.
    PasswordUtils
    Utility class for password hashing and verification.
    PermissionDeniedException
    Thrown when a user attempts an action without required permissions.
    RepositoryContext
    Container class that holds all repository instances for the Library Management System.
    Role
    Represents user roles in the Library Management System.
    SchedulerLogger
    Logging interface for scheduler-related events.
    SchedulerService
    Manages scheduled background tasks for the library management system.
    SearchByAuthorStrategy
    Strategy for searching books by author (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchByIdStrategy
    Strategy for searching books by ID.
    SearchByIsbnStrategy
    Strategy for searching books by ISBN (partial match).
    SearchByTitleStrategy
    Strategy for searching books by title (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchCDByArtistStrategy
    Strategy for searching CDs by artist (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchCDByIdStrategy
    Strategy for searching CDs by ID (supports partial matching).
    SearchCDByTitleStrategy
    Strategy for searching CDs by title (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchContext<T>
    Context class for the Search Strategy pattern.
    SearchCriteria
    Enumeration of available search and filter criteria for books.
    SearchJournalByAuthorStrategy
    Strategy for searching Journals by author/publisher (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchJournalByIdStrategy
    Strategy for searching Journals by ID (supports partial matching).
    SearchJournalByTitleStrategy
    Strategy for searching Journals by title (case-insensitive partial match).
    SearchStrategy<T>
    Strategy interface for searching and filtering loanable items.
    SearchUtils
    Utility class providing common search operations for library items.
    ServiceContext
    Central service container for the Library Management System.
    ServiceValidator
    Validates service dependencies to ensure they are properly initialized.
    StaticAccountRepository
    In-memory implementation of AccountRepository.
    StaticBookRepository
    In-memory implementation of BookRepository.
    StaticCDRepository
    In-memory implementation of CDRepository using a static HashMap.
    StaticJournalsRepository
    In-memory implementation of JournalsRepository using a static HashMap.
    StaticLoanRepository
    In-memory implementation of LoanRepository using a static HashMap.
    StaticUserRepository
    In-memory implementation of UserRepository using a static list.
    TransactionType
    Represents the type of financial transaction in the library system.
    User
    Represents a user in the Library Management System.
    UserCLI
    User command-line interface for the Library Management System.
    UserDTO
    Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing a user in a simplified form for use in the application layer or for transferring data between layers.
    UserManagementServices
    Groups services for user and authentication management.
    UserNotFoundException
    Thrown when a user cannot be found in the system.
    UserRepository
    Repository interface for managing User entities.
    UserService
    Application service for managing users in the Library Management System.
    UserValidator
    Validator for User entity fields.
